thread:
Ellen: Quick copy sync — we're finalizing hero and CTA segmentation for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need short hero options + one-liners per product by EOD Mon.
alex: Got it. Do we want separate hero UIs or a single hero with three CTAs?
morgan: I still prefer one hero, three CTAs. Cleaner for SEO and keeps above-the-fold simple.
Ellen: Agreed on one hero. Need 2 hero variants: benefit-first and numbers-first. Then micro-CTAs target by persona (developer, platform, security).
kai: For numbers-first, can we call out a single benchmark line? e.g., "p50 latency as low as 40ms, cut inference cost by 3x" — is that okay?
Ellen: Use cautious language: "industry-leading latency and unit economics" + a small stat callout like "p50 latency <50ms on Dedicated (typical)" — that'll be safe.
sam: I'll draft three micro-CTAs then: "Try Hosted API", "Reserve Dedicated", "Request Private eval". Each should set a hidden form field for routing.
Ellen: Routing detail: form should set lead_type = hosted | dedicated | private and utm_content = hero_cta. Dedicated leads -> 'dedicated_sales' queue; Private -> 'enterprise_ae'; Hosted -> inbound SDR.
alex: Can we add an alternate CTA for "Compare plans" that opens a quick modal? PMs liked that idea.
morgan: Modal is fine but keep primary CTAs persistent on mobile.
marketing-bot: Reminder: marketing doc updated -> https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123/edit (copy in "landing-copy/hero-variations") :spiral_note_pad:
Ellen: Thanks — please add final hero copy to that doc. Also we need short subhead bullets for each page: Hosted (fast onboarding, pay-as-you-go), Dedicated (predictable throughput, reserved GPUs), Private (VPC, compliance). Keep each bullet <=12 words.
kai: For Hosted subhead idea: "Start in minutes with a simple REST API and streaming" — ok?
Ellen: Good. For Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools and SLA-backed latency targets". For Private: "Customer-managed VPCs, KMS integration, and audit logs".
sam: On benchmark narrative — marketing wants a 1-paragraph blurb for the Dedicated page explaining methodology: sample workload (chat + 512 tokens), steady-state throughput measurements, quantization settings noted.
alex: We should link an appendix with methodology instead of putting all details on the page. Customers who care will click through.
morgan: Yes — add "see performance notes" link to a single-page appendix.
Ellen: Webinar tie-in: planning a short "Serving LLMs in Production" webinar right after launch. Need a sign-up funnel on the page that auto-tags registrants as "webinar" and their product interest.
marketing-bot: Event created: Webinar: Serving LLMs in Production — May 5. Registration form URL -> https://events.example.com/webinar-serve
kai: For messaging tone: more engineer-focused but not too technical on Hosted page. Dedicated/Private can have slightly more infra language.
sam: For inbound lead routing: HubSpot workflow names: hosted_inbound, dedicated_leads, private_enterprise. Make sure hidden field mapping matches these exact names.
Ellen: Also add a small trust/cred section: logos + one-line benchmark callout. Don't overpromise numbers in the hero.
alex: A/B test plan: Variant A = benefit-first hero. Variant B = numbers-first + small stat callout. Measure CTR to "Try Hosted API" and MQL conversion.
morgan: Experiment length: 2 weeks, 95% confidence, traffic split 50/50.
Ellen: Copy owners: alex = Hosted copy, kai = Dedicated + benchmark paragraph, sam = Private + inbound routing spec. I'll review tomorrow.
alex: Drafts pushed to doc, ping when ready for final tone pass.
marketing-bot: Deploy checklist updated: add GTM event for "hero_cta_click" and form hidden fields mapping. See /marketing/gtm/landing-tags.
sam: I'll add GTM events and HubSpot mappings. Will test a staging form by EOD.
Ellen: Awesome — last ask: include one sentence for SEO meta description per page (<= 155 chars). I'll collect and iterate after copy pass.
kai: I'll handle Dedicated meta line.
morgan: I'll write Hosted meta.
alex: Private meta done.
Ellen: Thanks team — schedule 20m readout Tues 10am. :calendar: 
alex: :thumbsup:
sam: :rocket:
